posts.name: Humble-Knight
posts.cooked:
So if we assume F6 is unlocked with ST, PW is unlocked with WotC, and the rest of the DW is unlocked with Vengeance, that leaves Eternal Haka, Redeemer Fanatic, Rogue Agent KNYFE, Beardy Ra, and then the new ones.

Obviously, Ra and Fanatic will be unlocked with IR. Eternal Haka is a good bet for the second mini expansion.

So, that leaves Rogue Agent KNYFE. She can't be unlocked with Wrath, because she won't be in the game yet, so I would put her in the Vengeance set with DW. 

That leaves the new ones, which will likely be unlocked with Villains. Any last promos will likely be bundled, both in real life and in the video game, with the final expansion.

As for villain promos, Spite and Gloomy will probably come with vengeance, maybe IR but doubtful.

These are just guesses but they all fit the time frame, give at least 2 promos per expansion except for the last mini, which doesn't need one, and fit either by timeline of release or by theme.

As for why we are getting Promo Expat but not fixer, maybe it's because he hasn't died yet. I'm not sure, but the stream didn't have his promo but it did have expat and legacy.
